5232-7487-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
5232-7487-8043.description:
Cast Clone Legion for free due to Vision, creating a token copy of each creature you control.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Zealous Lorecaster token enters, it triggers, returning Clone Legion from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2092-2464-4687.easyPrerequisites: Gilder Bairn does not have summoning sickness.
2092-2464-4687.notablePrerequisites:
Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has at least 2 power.
Song of Freyalise's first or second chapter ability has triggered this turn.
2092-2464-4687.description:
Activate Gilder Bairn's ability from Song of Freyalise by tapping it, adding {G/U}.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on target permanent.
Repeat.

967-3129-3809-6495-7087.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
967-3129-3809-6495-7087.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1170-4030-5131-6495--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-4030-5131-6495--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Starnheim Courser.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Repeat.
1170-4030-5131-6495--202.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

277-851-4094-4365-7942.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
277-851-4094-4365-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planet tokens.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

145-4067-7890.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three enchantments.
145-4067-7890.description:
Activate Serra's Sanctum by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}.
Activate Gleaming Splendor by paying {2}{W}, causing you and an opponent to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Serra's Sanctum.
Repeat.

1558-2638-4231-5233-7824.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-2638-4231-5233-7824.description:
Play Boros Garrison.
When Boros Garrison enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Bard.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3088-3899-4552-7803.notablePrerequisites: Brad Boimler has been tapped this turn.
539-3088-3899-4552-7803.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Xenic Poltergeist
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

955-3010-3259.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
955-3010-3259.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Moonblade Shinobi, triggering Breath of Fury and Moonblade Shinobi.
Resolve the Moonblade Shinobi trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1563-4927-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
1563-4927-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
1563-4927-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

2292-4907-6556-6989.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with power 4 or greater.
2292-4907-6556-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Temur Battlecrier. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

1477-2558-6705-6737.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters, Barret's first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Extruder by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Barret trigger, creating a 2/2 Rebel creature token and a 1/1 Frog creature token due to Quina.
When the Frog enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Frog.
Repeat from step 2.

2692-5686-7084.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Felidar Retreat triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

1809-1987-4276-6991.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
1809-1987-4276-6991.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Donnie & April and Returned Pastcaller.
When Donnie & April and Returned Pastcaller enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1809-1987-4276-6991.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

141-3505-4050.description:
Cast Second Sunrise by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Second Sunrise.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Second Sunrise
Resolve the Second Sunrise copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more brick counters on it

1805-2608-4499.description:
Activate Pyramid of the Pantheon by tapping it, adding {3}.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Derevi.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Pyramid of the Pantheon.
Repeat.

2060-4415-5060-6930.description:
Cast Stonecloaker by paying {W}.
Spider-Man India triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
When Stonecloaker enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

431-1270-3129-6441.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-1270-3129-6441.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of twelve 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature that does not have summoning sickness and that has power 1 or greater

262-549-2034-4853.description:
Activate the creature with Elemental Mastery attached by tapping it, creating a number of 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste equal to its power.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an Elemental.
When the Elemental dies as an artifact due to Biotransference, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping the creature with Elemental Mastery attached.
Repeat.

252-4871-4885.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature and have a way to cause that creature to die.
252-4871-4885.description:
Kill any other creature you control.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token that enters the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.

1115-1308-1563-2457.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

1-2275-5636-6282.notablePrerequisites:
You have a card in hand.
Your life total is at least 2.
1-2275-5636-6282.description:
Activate Psychic Frog by discarding a card.
Containment Construct triggers, exiling the discarded card with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Shabraz triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Shabraz.
Resolve the Psychic Frog ability.
Repeat.

1061-1350-5778.manaNeeded: {5}{W}{U} available the first turn, with {7}{W}{U}{U}{U} each following turn
1061-1350-5778.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven permanents and/or have the city's blessing.
1061-1350-5778.description:
Cast TImestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}, plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
If you control ten or more permanents and don't have the city's blessing, Timestream Navigator gives you the city's blessing.
When Timestream Navigator enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a token copy of it that is 1/1.
If you control ten or more permanents and don't have the city's blessing, the Timestream Navigator token gives you the city's blessing.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning the nontoken Timestream Navigator from the battlefield to your hand.
During your next turn, repeat steps 1 through 5 one additional time.
Activate the oldest Timestream Navigator token by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it from the battlefield onto the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat.

2034-2599-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ministrant of Obligation, adding {C}{C}.
When Ministrant of Obligation dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger,
Resolve the Ministrant of Obligation trigger, creating two creature tokens.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Ministrant of Obligation from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

474-1810-4050.description:
Cast Cackling Counterpart by paying {1}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Specimen Collector.
The Specimen Collector token enters the battlefield, creating a 1/1 Squirrel and a 0/3 Crab creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the nontoken Specimen Collector, adding one mana of any color.
Specimen Collector dies, creating a token copy of the Specimen Collector token.
Repeat from step 2.

1256-2713-4474-5153.notablePrerequisites:
Sunstrike Legionnaire does not have summoning sickness.
Paradise Mantle attached to Sunstrike Legionnaire.
1256-2713-4474-5153.description:
Tap Sunstrike Legionnaire to add {G}.
Pay {G} to create a 1/1 Saproling token.
Sunstrike Legionnaire triggers, untapping.
Repeat.
